name: The Accent
source:
A kinetic novel about two on-and-off “friends” sharing a moment on the couch before a surprise ending.

[From [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/Theaccent/460314]Gamejolt[/url]]
translation:
一部线性电子小说，讲述了两位分分合合、若即若离的“朋友”在沙发上共度片刻时光，并最终迎来出人意料结局的故事。

[摘自[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/Theaccent/460314]Game Jolt[/url]]
